title: Q3 激励在稀缺工况下的替代性
summary: Fleet scan (T018 integer MILP, K in {0,2,5,10,20}) shows real zone-level scarcity below 40 trucks: K=0 unmet 432.2 / dev 46,930, K=2 unmet 134.8 / dev 45,356. The T020 hybrid was then run at all five K for both source calibers and all four budgets (40 MILPs, same PZ/IPF/event order/costs). At every K every policy is more expensive than pure truck: the best diff is -30,686.6 (K=20) to -31,744.0 (K=5), and the largest payment ceiling (pure obj minus hybrid truck obj) is -686.6 CNY - negative, so even a zero reward cannot break even at the sampled reward levels. The mechanism is a price mismatch, not a coverage failure: at K=20 the arrivals B=30k policy removes all 95 unmet trips, but 30,000 CNY for 95 trips is 315.8 CNY per removed trip against the 6 CNY penalty; at K=2 it removes 112.0 of 134.8 unmet at 267.9 CNY each. Only 4.9% of reroutes cross a zone boundary (1,405 of 28,885) and ~17% of those land where they reduce a zone-hour imbalance, so ~258 reroutes buy one removed unmet trip. Conclusion: within K in [0,20] the incentive is never worthwhile; it is justified as a design and a budget rule, not as a saving.

notes: Unmet is not monotone in K: K=5 returns 0 unmet while K=10 and K=20 return 64.4 and 95.0. These are near-optimal solutions at a 1% MIP gap, so the unmet component can move within the gap; the comparison that matters is the objective, which is monotone in K on the scan (143,384.5 / 139,418.9 / 133,719.1 / 126,272.7 / 112,173.0 / 84,860.0 / 83,807.7). The reported unmet at K=10/20 is an upper bound, not a proven minimum.

The payment ceiling is a diagnostic at the sampled reward levels, not a free dial: payment and q are linked through r. Its negative sign is nevertheless robust because the smallest payment in the set is 30,000 CNY while the largest possible truck-side benefit is bounded by the MILP gap (<=1,434 CNY at K=0) and by 3.3305 x positive zone-hour arrivals.

At K=0 the model is an LP (no integer trucks), so the -1,739 to -3,205 CNY truck-objective increase is exact, not gap noise. The incentive raises the K=0 objective because the Q3 surplus/deficit cells are hourly and cell-level, while T018 prices the end-of-day zone deviation: arrivals moved into a cell that is short in its own worst hour can land in a zone-hour where the zone is already long.
The Q3 LP and the IPF-refitted PZ are K-independent; the same 8 policies are applied to every K, so differences across K come only from the truck model.
